title: Filter by IP Address
use_case: Filters all packets sent to or received from a specific target IP address (both source and destination).
expected_output: Displays only network traffic involving the specified IP, isolating it from background noise.

title: Filter by TCP Port
use_case: Inspects traffic on a specific TCP port such as port 80 (HTTP), 443 (HTTPS), or a suspicious port.
expected_output: Displays only TCP packets entering or leaving the specified port number.

title: Inspect HTTP POST Requests
use_case: Captures data submissions sent to a web server, such as login credentials, form inputs, or exploit payloads.
expected_output: Displays only HTTP POST requests, allowing you to use 'Follow HTTP Stream' to inspect the transmitted payload.
